K-03 Ryś (Lynx) was selected as the replacement for the wz. 93 Pantera as the default Combat uniform camouflage pattern for the entire Polish Armed Forces and soldiers from all branches of military are set to receive it by the end of 2028. Ryś (Lynx) was developed in close cooperation between Polish Special Forces and experts from the Military Research and Implementation Center for Uniformed Services in Łódź. It competed with other patterns that were previously also under consideration such as Lampart, MultiCam, WS 62 and WS 31. During evaluation its properties have shown nearly 33% lower detectability during the day than the wz. 93 Pantera and almost twice lower detectability at night than the MultiCam. The design itself is based on five naturally occurring colors carefully selected to seamlessly match the Polish natural landscape and disrupt the silhouette.
